_comment: Charity walks on Neon One RallyBound / Neon Fundraise. mapsee_ingest_rallybound.py reads each tenant's own event-finder widget API (GET /widgetapi/EventsLite, optionally ?eventSeriesId=N): one request per tenant. robots.txt on both hosts ends in 'Allow: /' with nothing under /widgetapi/ (checked 2026-10-11; the adapter asks again every run). No usage policy for the widget API was found, so it is read as a publisher feed bound by robots.txt. Measured 2026-10-11: Kidney Walk 20 walks (all placed), Great Strides 7 (5 placed, 2 'TBD'). Read the adapter's header before changing a rule.
_within_days: Walks starting within this many days are written. Both programmes are seasonal (fall, spring), so 180 days reaches the next season's first walks without listing a whole year ahead.
